source_read_mode: git show of fixed commit only; original conflicted worktree was not modified or run

scaling.rule: existing cockpit-unit = viewport width / 1920 px; fixed source px scale by 2/3 at1280

scaling.limit: Only the listed local dimensions are sourced. The outer card/sidebar width and absolute vertical position are existing adaptations, not independently established source rectangles.

display_contract.both_arrows: toggle the same local hangar/drone selection; no original typeChange business event
display_contract.identity: Names, place and serial number remain unprovided. Context IDs are shown only as explicitly labeled resource identifiers.
display_contract.hangar_online: always unknown; no authoritative hangar field exists in the current snapshot contract
display_contract.drone_online: only boolean state.online from a ready, available, successfully read snapshot; false stays offline; missing/invalid/unavailable/read failure stays unknown
display_contract.occupancy: No cabin-in/out claim; airborne and task state cannot substitute for uavInHangar.
display_contract.facts_adaptation: Keep existing bound project/task/control facts; existing battery/link rows are explicitly labeled as UAV values.
display_contract.responsive_arrangement_limit: The outer content width remains the existing335px adaptation at both desktop widths. Local source dimensions scale with cockpit-unit: the online badge wraps below the portrait/text at1920, but fits on the same row toward the right at1280. This is not a claim that the complete internal arrangement matches source pixels across resolutions; the outer sidebar is not changed in this slice.
display_contract.title_artwork: Existing adapted section-title artwork is retained. This slice does not claim the original title artwork or all device details are restored.
display_contract.continuity: Same CockpitSession, request client, confirmation lifecycle, Teleport authority buttons, and Cesium canvas.

test_input_source: Existing synthetic HTTP fixture; API boundary only is substituted. Vue, DOM, CSS, Chrome pointer input and Cesium are real local implementations.
evidence_limit: Offline UI behavior and source-local geometry only; no model understanding score, full test-environment visual acceptance, Java deployment or physical flight result.
